claims.text: Patient reports thinking they are allergic to ibuprofen, which makes them wheezy.

citations.quote: I think I am allergic to ibuprofen, it makes me wheezy.

open_questions: Which medications were started, stopped, held or changed? The record contains no medication change entries.
Is the reported ibuprofen allergy recorded in a structured allergy list? Only a patient note reports it.
When was the ibuprofen-related wheeze first recorded, and are there earlier entries of wheeze or asthma symptoms after NSAIDs? No earlier entries are present.
Was any prior ibuprofen or NSAID prescription recorded, and was it stopped? No such prescription appears in the record.
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding? No such entries are present.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Patient-reported wheeze after ibuprofen may indicate NSAID hypersensitivity, and it is not documented in a structured allergy list.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Confirm the reported ibuprofen reaction and whether it is recorded in the structured allergy list.
